svg.text: c0_Y1033 (trump5) -- CONTACT CENSUS of the eight budget-0 assignments under BR(0,1)=H+F1 / TR(0,1)=H+F1 (A186, 2026-09-09)

Per panel: the eleven boxes (pins light blue; free roles = hull of the multibox pieces with the tilt range), the candidate contact graph (grey edges: pairs the pieces cannot certify apart, thicker = deeper possible overlap; dashed ticks = possible wall contacts), and the measured stuck configuration (global186).

Theorem CC (docs/proofs/contact_census.md): the node is dead iff every Fritz-John point of every selection, box faces included, has side > s0; solved by the selection tree (tree186, CAPPED [P]) -- no witness, no kill; the least overlap found is the column P2 | F2 | F3.
